name: Sonas B&B

tagline.en: A family welcome in the heart of the Carna Gaeltacht, with views out to Mynish Island and the Aran Islands.
tagline.ga: Fáilte teaghlaigh i gcroílár Ghaeltacht Charna, le radharc amach ar Oileán Mhuighinse agus ar Oileáin Árann.

en: Sonas is a family-run B&B in Carna village, in the heart of the Connemara Gaeltacht, where Irish is spoken every day. Ann puts the emphasis on friendliness and your comfort.

From the house there are panoramic views of Mynish Island and the Aran Islands in the distance. Unspoilt sandy beaches, Irish music in the local bars and fresh seafood are all within walking distance.
Sonas is approved by Fáilte Ireland.
ga: Is B&B teaghlaigh é Sonas i sráidbhaile Charna, i gcroílár Ghaeltacht Chonamara, áit a labhraítear Gaeilge gach lá. Cuireann Ann béim ar an gcairdiúlacht agus ar do chompord.
Ón teach tá radharc leathan ar Oileán Mhuighinse agus ar Oileáin Árann i bhfad uait. Tá tránna gainimh, ceol Gaelach sna tithe tábhairne áitiúla agus bia mara úr ar fad siúlóid uait.
Tá Sonas faofa ag Fáilte Ireland.
